help.en: Helping others is the best way to feel happy.
help.cn: 帮助别人是让自己开心的最好方式。

volunteer.en: Many volunteers worked at the park last weekend.
volunteer.cn: 上周末很多志愿者在公园工作。

elderly.en: Many elderly people live near our school.
elderly.cn: 学校附近住着很多老人。

kind.en: Kind words can make someone's whole day brighter.
kind.cn: 友善的话能让别人一天都明亮。

smile.en: A simple smile is the shortest helping hand.
smile.cn: 一个简单的微笑就是最短的援手。

share.en: We share our food and stories with the elderly.
share.cn: 我们把食物和故事分享给老人。

neighbour.en: Our neighbours are kind and often share fresh vegetables.
neighbour.cn: 我们的邻居很好，常给我们送新鲜蔬菜。

warm.en: Small acts of kindness make the world a warmer place.
warm.cn: 小小善举让世界更温暖。
